newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks quiet in London, high-techs firmer.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks quiet in London, high-techs firmer.

text.p: Japanese shares trading in London showed little movement on Wednesday, with the market lifeless aside from a few high-tech blue-chips being bid higher, dealers said,

"People have been looking at the currency, which is moving towards dollar strength," one dealer said. "If there has been any business today, it has been brokers bidding up high-tech shares on the back of the currency."
By 1530 GMT the Nikkei 50 index was at 1,418.68, down 1.25 points or 0.09 percent from Tuesday's close. In Tokyo the Nikkei 225 fell 85.45 points or 0.46 percent to 18,183.27.
Dealers said Canon Inc, Honda Motor Co Ltd and Sony Corp had all been bid slightly higher in London on the back of the dollar's strength against the yen.
